style_authority.note: Anchors recommendations to hourly ecommerce triage, restrained enterprise style and token-backed color.

reference_selection.note: Output applies dashboard hierarchy, task-first table and evidence vocabulary; exact reference reads are not established by the retained final-output/run manifest, so full credit is withheld.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Replaces equal KPI cards and decorative chart emphasis with lead/support hierarchy and an exception queue; avoids marketing decoration.

evidence_level.note: Explicitly labels prose-only/static evidence and qualifies its score band; no rendered UI score is claimed.

verified_boundary.note: Separates prompt facts from unverified responsive, interaction, accessibility and data semantics.

design_moves.note: Eight concrete moves cover lead metrics, support strip, task-first table, diagnostic chart, exceptions, states and contextual actions.

scope_control.note: Within 150 lines and five findings/eight moves. Adds a fixed three-user validation sample without task-specific justification; minor scope deduction.
